name: EMP E / Phase Interlock

revision_basis.source: latest user review of r0.2 on real Chrome WebGPU
reported_quality_gaps: normal release remained too close to thin parallel cyan lines; source->target transport and receiver response were weak
cancellation read too much like thin cyan/amber vertical lines disappearing; interlock and erasure front were weak at H64
resonance hub was identifiable, but strongest local luminance, surrounding response, and dark/light modulation needed improvement
revision_basis.status_note: Those observations apply to r0.2. r0.3 in this ZIP has not been re-run on real GPU or re-listened by the assistant.

latest_instruction: Keep common action E digital, with in-world information-state and field-structure changes per cause. Do not fake digitality with post-added grid/scanline/particles/bloom. Preserve event contracts. Avoid Sol/Astra/Codex legacy references.

implemented_changes.normal_release: Redesigned as source readout gate + finite transport body + moving packet cells + target clamp + local nearby response. White core is limited to narrow ridges tied to world geometry.
implemented_changes.resonance: Redesigned around a thicker shared hub with dark mass, three shared spine bars, six radiating couplers, and stronger local luminance concentrated at the hub.
implemented_changes.cancellation: Redesigned as broad complementary wedges feeding a central null trench with a readable downward erasure front and simultaneous remaining-vs-erased structure.
implemented_changes.charge_and_lock_audit: Authority/lifetime behavior preserved; only minor helper ribs/buses added where useful. No new gameplay meaning, autonomous discharge, or extension restart.

node_tests.scope: state, sampler, geometry, PCM, AudioWorklet JS harness, and static pipeline descriptors; not actual GPU or listening

B_structural.scope: local structural validator only; not an official bundled validator

browser_attempt.reason: Local Chromium navigation to localhost was blocked by environment policy before app navigation.

known_limits: Transparent-triangle depth sorting remains approximate at intersections; visual acceptability on actual hardware is unverified.
H64 proxy is not final character art.
Rate changes pitch; there is no pitch-preserving time stretch.
Voice budget is 64, retained events 1024, commands 50000; host side remains responsible for epoch/capacity policy.
No hidden server branch logic, pair detection, damage, inventory mutation, unprovided authority extension, or causal cancellation is introduced.
reproducibility: optional tests/browser-smoke.py or --full on allowed real hardware
manifest_policy: SHA256SUMS covers all packaged files except itself; ZIP SHA-256 is reported outside the ZIP to avoid recursive hashing.
